sources.title: Acacia finish packages and school verification
sources.content: At Acacia, every home is expertly designed with one of three professionally curated finish packages — Warm, Cool, or Model. Acacia is in the Palo Alto Unified School District (PAUSD). School assignments are subject to capacity limitations and boundary changes as determined by the PAUSD School Board. For current assignments, contact PAUSD at 650.329.3700 or https://www.pausd.org/.
